I need to search across the main directories (cmd, internal, proto, server, and web) outside the store package itself to count which packages depend on each store type, giving me a sense of how widely each entity is used across the application.

args.command:

done

Looking at the data layer (`store` package in this codebase, [usememos/memos](https://github.com/usememos/memos)), the persistent entity types are the core structs like `User`, `Memo`, `Attachment`, `Inbox`, `MemoShare`, `MemoRelation`, `Reaction`, `UserSetting`, `UserIdentity`, `IdentityProvider`, and `InstanceSetting`, defined across files such as `store/user.go`, `store/memo.go`, `store/attachment.go`, `store/inbox.go`, etc.

Counting distinct packages outside `store/` that reference each type (via `store.<Type>`):

- `store.User`: referenced from `server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss` → 7 packages
- `store.Memo`: referenced from `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload` → 6 packages
- `store.Attachment`: 4 packages
- `store.Inbox`, `store.MemoShare`, `store.MemoRelation`: 3 packages each
- `store.UserIdentity`, `store.Reaction`: 2 packages each
- `store.UserSetting`, `store.IdentityProvider`, `store.InstanceSetting`: 1 package each

Answer: 1st: `User` (`store/user.go`) — ~7 packages; 2nd: `Memo` (`store/memo.go`) — ~6 packages
